description: The newest federal lobbying disclosures as they post to lda.gov: new registrations (a firm hired by a new client), terminations, quarterly reports and amendments, with client, firm, amount, issues and lobbyists. Optionally filter by kind, issue code or a name.

issue_code.description: Optional three-letter LDA issue code, e.g. "HCR", "DEF", "TAX".

kind.description: new = registrations, ended = terminations, reports = quarterly reports. Default all.

limit.description: How many filings to return. Default 10.

query.description: Optional company, firm or issue name to narrow to (past 12 months).

name: latest_filings
title: Latest lobbying filings
